clayresearch.statement: Integrated Clay architecture should explicitly classify compiler-carried state into semantic first-class fields, verified external bindings and truly non-semantic trace/debug metadata; optimizer convenience cannot decide the class.

frank.statement: FRANK architecture contracts should mark authority, resource/effect identity, epistemic UNKNOWN/CONFLICT/REVOKED state and causally required provenance as lowering-critical so H2 cannot silently compile them away.

gwt.statement: No GWT mechanism change. Existing delivery/reconstruction/use/effect/reentry distinctions remain; when represented in compiled ClayCode, any causally required receipt fields fall under the same preservation gate.

emergenz.statement: No emergence claim or metric change. The finding only protects intervention/measurement state from accidental lowering loss.

claycode.statement: Implement a field-classified LoweringWitness/translation validator in compiler/runtime work. AUTHORITY must monotonically attenuate, EPISTEMIC_STATE must remain exact across pure lowering, PROVENANCE must remain exact or hash/epoch-bound when externalized, and effect/resource semantics must remain optimizer-visible. Treat this as CC-WP-06/11/13 implementation work, not a semantic redesign unless a real executable counterexample forces one.

hyperposition.statement: No new topology mechanism. Existing set-valued alternatives/conflicts used by program semantics must not be collapsed by lowering unless an explicit semantic transform proves equivalence.

claygraph.statement: Graph provenance/relevance/activation remains non-authoritative. Compiler lowering must not accidentally convert graph-derived relevance into capability authority; graph state that is causally used must have exact or validated target semantics.

unifieddb.statement: Provenance externalization is acceptable only with deterministic binding from target artifact/receipt to exact derivation hash and source epoch. Canonical ledger storage cannot substitute for target semantic values needed at execution time and cannot mint authority.

harness.statement: Add semantic-lowering mutation/differential tests to the H2 path: intentionally drop/broaden each critical field after source canonicalization and require translation validation to fail closed before execution. Later H-WP-20 differential should compare these obligations in addition to state/output equality.

stage_gate_effect.BASE_CLAYCODE_RELEASE: NO_PASS_CHANGE; new validation constraint/de-risking result only

authority_boundary: This manifest is research feedback. It does not authorize Frank to mutate its own Harness and does not itself authorize any external effect.
